name: potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 8

function.text: KCNJ8 is the approved symbol for potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 8. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ATP-activated inward rectifier potassium channel activity; ATPase-coupled monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity; kidney development.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include hypertrichotic osteochondrodysplasia Cantu type (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.
